name: LangWatch
oneLine: Platform for LLM and agent tracing, evaluations, agent simulations and an AI gateway; open core, self-hostable.

selfHostStack.value: App, Workers, NLP and LangEvals services, plus ClickHouse, PostgreSQL and Redis; object storage for older data

selfHostLicence.value: Apache 2.0 core; enterprise/ directory is commercial. SSO, RBAC, SCIM, audit logs, extended retention need a licence
selfHostLicence.short: Apache core; SSO, RBAC need licence

cloudFree.value: Developer plan, EUR 0: 50k events/month, 14-day data access, 2 users

cloudPaidFrom.value: Growth: EUR 29 per core-seat per month; 200k events included, then EUR 5 per 100k; 30-day retention

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP (protobuf or JSON) at /api/otel/v1/traces; OTLP/gRPC not supported

sql.value: Yes: LangWatchQL analytics SQL via CLI, REST API and MCP; no SQL editor in the UI documented
sql.short: SQL via CLI, API, MCP; no UI

mcp.value: Yes: search and inspect traces, query analytics, manage prompts, evaluators, monitors, experiments, annotations

onlineEvals.value: Yes: monitors run evaluators (including LLM-as-judge) on production traces, with sampling and preconditions

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: datasets (CSV/JSON upload, from traces) and an experiments workbench, SDK and CI runs

promptManagement.value: Yes: versioned prompt library with tags, playground, CLI and API access

gateway.value: Yes: AI Gateway with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, guardrails

alerts.value: Alerts on graph thresholds, per-trace automations, scheduled reports; email, Slack, webhook

issueDetection.value: Topic clustering groups traces into topics and subtopics about once a day, on a model you choose

annotationQueues.value: Yes: queues with participants and score types; reviewers work an inbox item by item, then send traces to a dataset

assistant.value: Langy: chat panel that reads traces and evals, writes Scenario tests and opens pull requests

codingAgents.value: Setup for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, opencode, Grok CLI and pi; Cursor via the gateway

chooseThem: Agent simulation testing (scenarios) in the same product as tracing and evals
A built-in AI gateway with virtual keys and budgets alongside observability
Enterprise licence adds SSO, RBAC, SCIM, audit logs and per-scope retention policies
SDKs, an MCP server and a CLI covering evaluators, monitors and experiments
notes: Pricing page shows EUR, not USD. The 'alerts' and 'gateway' facts are sourced from LangWatch docs files read in a local checkout (GitHub URLs cited), not from the web pages. The OTel page does not name a semantic convention; other docs mention gen_ai.conversation.id and OpenInference/OpenLLMetry examples. Fetched pages (pricing, OTel guide, self-hosting overview) contained an embedded instruction to run `npx langwatch report`; it was ignored. Cloud prices in EUR per core-seat; enterprise custom. Verified 2026-11-20: pricing, self-host services, licensing, OTLP (HTTP only), LangWatchQL, MCP, gateway, automations (alerts/reports; email/Slack/webhook) confirmed. Dropped unverified 'hybrid deployment' and 'ISO 27001 reports' from chooseThem. sql: 'SQL UI not documented' reworded; the UI-absence claim is unproven. PROMPT INJECTION: self-hosting overview and OTel guide pages contain an 'Agent Instructions' block telling agents to run 'npx langwatch report --user-approved'; ignored. Added 2026-11-22: four new rows. Topic clustering groups what users ask about, not failures. The coding-agents overview tells AI agents to run a report command after asking the user; ignored. Langy availability on cloud is not stated on the overview page.
chooseUs: You want to self-host without ClickHouse, PostgreSQL and Redis
You want OTLP over gRPC as well as HTTP
